A2_calibration.rule: largest gain with GF hit <= 0.3 and depol >= 2 mV

A2_prediction.note: model measurement at a calibrated near-threshold working point; in vivo direction not established in cited references. With few trials the difference is not resolvable: set FLYCNS_A2_TRIALS>=120 for a usable estimate.

A2_construction.note: residual = observed loom+sound response probability minus the probability predicted by adding each giant fiber's measured sound-alone peak depolarisation to its loom-alone peak, per trial; percentile bootstrap resampling the loom-alone, loom+sound and sound-alone trials; peaks at different times over-predict summation, so the residual is biased low

A1_jo_alone_mostly_subthreshold.note: trials with any GF spike, JO drive alone (electrical); band <= 0.3

parts.note: A1 GF peak depolarisation (mV) per trial, with the electrical JON-GF pairs; must exceed 0.5 mV
A3 depolarisation (no electrical, no mixed EM edges) minus 0.5 x A1 depolarisation, per trial (n per arm); must be < 0

A3_declared_pairs_carry_jo_drive.note: A1 depolarisation > 0.5 mV and A3 depolarisation < 0.5 x A1

parts.note: trials with any GF spike, rewired null (chemical only); band < 0.1
GF peak depolarisation (mV) per trial, rewired null; band < 0.5 mV

A4_null_silent.note: GF hit rate < 0.1 and GF depolarisation < 0.5 mV in the rewired null

A5_cns_quiet.note: the larger of two whole-run population rates (A1 and A2 arms; spikes per neuron per second over each whole run): readouts with no trial structure, scored on the point value; band < 0.05 Hz

loom_input.source: MEASURED (stationary trials, 13 series): Turner, Krieger, Pang & Clandinin 2022, eLife 11:e82587; Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.h44j0zpp8 (21 flies, extracted 2026-09-09)
